title: Explicit Green's Functions and Adjoint Problems for Differential Equations with Linear Functional Perturbations
summary: In this paper we study a functional differential equation subject to two-point boundary value conditions, where the functional dependence is introduced through an operator of the form \begin{equation*} \sum_{k=1}^{l}γ_{k}(t)\mathcal{C}_{k}(u), \end{equation*} where $\mathcal{C}_{k}:C(I) \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$, $k=1, \ldots l$, ($I:=[a,b]$) are linear continuous operators and $γ_{k} \in \mathcal{L}^{1}(I)$ for all $k=1, \ldots, l$. This formulation encompasses, among others, equations with piecewise constant arguments and those with integral-type dependence. We analyze this class of…
